paragraphs: R' Gamliel the son of R' Ilai: Shevuot, end of chapter 5; Yohanan the son of Rabbi Ilai: Sukkah 27b.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Sukkah 27b paragraph names Yohanan beRabbi Ilai, supporting that second father’s local full title. The separate Gamliel pointer at the end of Shevuot chapter 5 was not independently collated here, so its two abbreviated personal titles remain R'. The book search removed its filter and returned unrelated material, which is not source evidence. Neither pointer establishes a common father or an identity binding.
